## Completed example

*Illustrative example; replace these details with your own verified record.*

**Bounded contribution:** For applied sport settings using repeated self-report measures, the thesis identifies decision requirements, bounds interpretation of within-athlete change and demonstrates a recoverable reporting workflow. It does not establish that using the workflow improves health or performance.

| Component | Distinct contribution | Whole-thesis role | Boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| practitioner study | identifies decisions and current variation | define | reported practice, not effectiveness |
| measurement study | establishes interpretable conditions | test | selected measures and setting |
| workflow study | demonstrates recoverable implementation | integrate | reproducibility, not outcome impact |

## Check your record

Trace each part of the whole-thesis claim to a precise location. Distinguish demonstrated contribution from possible future use, and the candidate's work from collaborators' contributions.

## Scenario test

The map says “first comprehensive framework” but supplies no search scope or comparison. Remove “first”, conduct the bounded verification or narrow the claim to what the thesis evidence directly demonstrates.

## Evidence of done

Each claim links to the exact submitted thesis; component roles do not duplicate one another; candidate and collaborator work are transparent; and sceptical challenges have a response or explicit boundary.
